testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore the document tab strip ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open ✔ And document tabs are visible ✔ When the user clears Document Tabs in the View tab's User Interface menu ✔ Then the document tab strip disappears ✔ And the active document remains displayed ✔ And Document Tabs is unchecked in the User Interface menu ✔ When the user selects Document Tabs in the same menu ✔ Then the document tab strip reappears ✔ And Document Tabs is checked in the User Interface menu ✔ And the open documents are available as tabs
